useWhen: Coordinating delivery of work across multiple skills
Breaking down a goal into executable tasks with dependencies
Managing scope boundaries for a delivery

workflow.description: Extract stated goal or outcome, identify success criteria, determine constraints. Ask clarifying questions if goal is vague
Decompose goal into discrete, executable tasks. Each task should be self-contained, specific, and atomic. Group into workstreams
Map dependencies as directed graph. Identify hard dependencies, soft dependencies, shared resources, and critical path
Assess complexity using T-shirt sizing: S (single skill), M (2-3 skill calls), L (multiple skill calls with complex handoffs)
Define explicit in-scope and out-of-scope items. Identify scope creep risks
Order tasks to minimize blockers. Group parallelizable tasks into stages. Flag circular dependencies
Present structured delivery plan with tasks, dependencies, stages, scope boundaries, and complexity ratings

examples.input: Break down building a new SaaS feature into executable tasks
examples.output: Delivery plan with task registry, dependency map, stage sequencing, and scope boundaries
examples.context: Need to coordinate multiple skills for feature delivery

examples.input: We have blocked tasks - help re-sequence the delivery plan
examples.output: Updated delivery plan with resolved dependencies, re-ordered stages, and blocker status report
examples.context: Delivery blocked by dependencies or unclear next steps
